changelog:
Initial release of the Logo Creator skill for AI agents.

- Enables creation of professional, minimalist vector-style logos using basic geometric shapes and negative space.
- Includes guidelines for color, typography, flat design, and scalability across all logo types.
- Provides a protocol for prompt optimization and structured brand briefs.
- Enforces strict production constraints for consistency and legibility.
- Supports multiple logo styles (pictorial, abstract, lettermark, emblem, mascot) with clear use cases.
summary: Engineer professional-grade brand logos using geometric primitives and negative space — generates minimalist, scalable vector-style marks via muapi.ai
